servers.description: New list of DNS servers to configure.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the DNS server.

search_domains.description: New list of search domains to configure.

interface_name.description: The name of the network interface to apply DNS configuration to. Accepts alphanumeric names or @fact. references.

override_dhcp.description: When true, disables DHCP-provided DNS servers so only the configured servers are used. When false or omitted, DHCP DNS servers are merged alongside the configured ones (default Netplan behavior).
